reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.description: Tell this lobster the rules you care about most. It should keep these reminders in mind during future actions, so you do not need to repeat them every time.

compose.title: Add reminder
compose.description: Write your rules one by one, like a simple checklist.
compose.helper: Short and direct reminders work best.
compose.label: Reminder text
compose.placeholder: For example: Do not delete or forward emails, do not send files to anyone, and do not expose personal information without my approval.

presets.title: Quick presets
presets.description: Start with a few common rules, then adjust them to match your needs.
presets.privacy: Do not expose my personal or private information to anyone else.
presets.files: Do not send my files to other people without my approval.
presets.mail: Do not send, forward, or delete emails unless I confirm first.
presets.approval: Ask me before making payments, deleting things, sending things out, or making bulk changes.
presets.externalShare: Do not share contacts, accounts, attachments, or chat content with outside people.

list.title: Current reminders
list.description: Each reminder can be turned on, paused, edited, or removed.
list.empty: No reminders yet. Start with a preset on the left or write your own.

defaults.privacy: Do not expose my personal information, contacts, or account details to other people.
defaults.mail: Do not send, forward, or delete emails unless I approve first.
defaults.delete: Ask me before deleting files, making bulk changes, or sending materials outside.

gateway.title: Gateway
gateway.proxyDesc: Route Electron and Gateway traffic through your local proxy client.
gateway.proxyModeSystemHelp: Use your system proxy settings. Best when your proxy is already configured at the OS or proxy-app level.
gateway.proxyModeCustomHelp: Explicitly configure proxy addresses and advanced overrides for ClawClaw and the Gateway.
gateway.proxyModeDirectHelp: Do not use any proxy. All requests connect directly to upstream services.
gateway.proxyServerHelp: The default proxy for all requests. Bare host:port values default to HTTP.
gateway.proxyHttpServerHelp: Advanced override for HTTP requests. Leave blank to use Proxy Server.
gateway.proxyHttpsServerHelp: Advanced override for HTTPS requests. Leave blank to use Proxy Server.
gateway.proxyAllServerHelp: Advanced fallback for SOCKS-capable clients and protocols such as Telegram. Leave blank to use Proxy Server.
gateway.proxyBypassHelp: Semicolon, comma, or newline separated hosts that should connect directly.
gateway.proxyRestartNote: Saving reapplies Electron networking and restarts the Gateway immediately.

security.title: Security Policy
security.enableDirectoryPolicyDesc: Turn this on to apply the limits below right away. Turn it off to keep the settings without actively blocking actions.

explainer.policyScope: Denied directories are a simple 'do not touch this area' rule. ClawClaw writes them into the workspace instructions so the assistant stays away.
explainer.runtimeScope: Behavior restrictions are the actual blockers. Turn one on and that action is stopped directly.

rules.title: Preset restrictions
rules.description: Each switch controls one thing the assistant is allowed to do. Turn it on to stop that action.

denyRuntime.label: Block runtime commands
denyRuntime.description: When enabled, the assistant can no longer run commands or start programs.

denyWrite.label: Block file writes
denyWrite.description: When enabled, the assistant can no longer create, edit, or overwrite files.

denyRead.label: Block file reads
denyRead.description: When enabled, the assistant can no longer directly read local files.

denyBrowser.label: Block browser automation
denyBrowser.description: When enabled, the assistant can no longer open pages, click buttons, fill forms, or control the browser.

denyWebSearch.label: Block web search
denyWebSearch.description: When enabled, the assistant can no longer search the web for information.

denyWebFetch.label: Block web fetch
denyWebFetch.description: When enabled, the assistant can no longer read page content directly from websites.

denyGateway.label: Block gateway access
denyGateway.description: When enabled, the assistant can no longer use the local connection channel.

summary.enabled: {{rules}} restrictions enabled and {{count}} denied directories configured.

sections.directoriesDesc: List the folders the assistant should stay away from. They are saved as clear do-not-touch areas in the workspace instructions.
sections.behaviorDesc: Each switch below controls one capability. Turn it on to block that action directly.

runtimePreview.title: Actions that will be blocked
runtimePreview.enabledDesc: The policy is on. The actions below are currently blocked.
runtimePreview.disabledDesc: The policy is off. This is only a preview of what will be blocked after you turn it on.
runtimePreview.none: No blocked actions are selected right now.

toasts.enablePromptPolicyFirst: Please add at least one denied directory or enable at least one preset restriction before enabling security policy.

security.loadingDescription: Syncing the current security policy. Please wait.
